command.name: schema
command.summary: Describe every command this build contains
command.description:
Prints the command surface as data: flags with types and enums, required inputs, whether a command mutates or destroys, its output kind, and the exit codes it can produce.
With no argument it lists every command. With a dotted command name it prints that one command in full. It is generated from the same registry that builds the command tree, so it cannot drift from what the binary actually does — and it lists only what this build contains.

exit-codes.exit-code: Bad flags, missing required input, unsupported combination
Succeeded but result set was truncated

command.example: jr schema jr schema version jr schema --format json
